rv.q: Although it's a jaunty, likable show, it never persuades you that Haines was a tragic martyr or a west coast Wilde...
A compelling story, fine tunes and some rather attractive actors make for a highly enjoyable evening.

cn.t: This stylish musical about silent film star William Haines and his 50-year relationship charms with wit and period glamour, though it struggles to convey deeper tragic stakes beyond its jaunty, likable surface.
